scope: exact RF-02F pure mean-unit source, root synthetic qualification and independent temporal/failure probes; no historical or integration acceptance

root_qualification.prior_attempt_limit: The preserved first attempt failed one rounding-sensitive retention assertion. Source hash is identical in both reports; final test uses its stated rounding tolerance while all 99 ordinary diagonal path checks remain exact.

accepted_findings: Every one of 18 off-diagonal settings across all 13 variants retains the exact inherited forecast_origin method and internal E2 failure/mean semantics. The factory copies incoming settings; ordinary tied paths directly return the original class.

A later off-diagonal forecast has its own means demonstrably different from diagonal E2. Delayed delivery after another result changes state according to that original off-diagonal mean, not a later or archived diagonal expectation. Mutating the returned forecast array does not change stored learning expectations.

Shuffled delivery uses the original game-season/week deterministic mapping even across a two-year delay; old-season result increments are applied before common retention. The independent seed and S/P arithmetic probe matches final O/D state.

All 27 settings retain exactly zero disabled S or P coordinates for their respective new removals over multiple games, 2020 weighting and season gaps. These variants retain distinct trajectories even at nominally tied gains.
Future/same-origin, disappearing-history, wrong-target, duplicate-target and repeated-target guards precede state mutation in the tested public precondition paths.
All 13 off-diagonal variants retain absorbing nonfinite-dynamic-state failure across later delivery and offseason transitions, without reset.
Finite nonpositive forecasts remain native invalid_mean without creating an absorbing failure; later updates use the original raw invalid mean as in frozen E2, never an external fallback mean.

Source inspection and root noise tests retain pre-noise learning expectations, original deterministic seeds and copied noise output. Independent-marginal and availability timing effects remain outside this pure mean unit.
required_integration_obligations: Authenticate immutable historical input row contents on every relevant closure. The inherited unit checks delivered identity membership but does not hash-bind or reject changes to already-delivered score contents on a later call; the explicit probe demonstrates a changed league mean.

Treat a delivery validation error as fatal for that run/instance. The inherited delivered_context_mismatch check occurs after adding the game to delivered; the explicit probe confirms partial mutation. Do not retry the same instance or claim transactional rollback.
The factory validates settings at construction; callers must freeze the experiment configuration rather than mutate public model internals later.

Supply the actual prior-only 12/24-hour prepared inputs, fixed same-game fallback and mapper controls, exact original order and independent selection/score/inference admission. The pure unit cannot establish these caller guarantees.
limitations: This accepts only the exact additive pure mean unit within the reviewed numerical/temporal synthetic scope. It is not full RF-02F protocol, archive reuse, selection, integration, qualification, cost-pilot or historical pre-fit approval.

No historical artifact, historical forecast, model fit, distribution fit, scorer, provider, site, production or publication operation was invoked. Synthetic state updates used invented football contexts and scores.

Root qualification provenance is its preserved report/process/log and matching source hashes; this reviewer did not witness that prior live process. The eight independent probes were run and completed in this review.
The measured subsecond synthetic runtime is not an equivalent-workload compute speedup estimate and does not predict historical replay cost.
Historical issuance, prospective evidence and predictive improvement are untested.
